rules.source_quote: The applicant must be a widow in the age group of 40-79 years.

rules.note: SOURCE CONFLICT — needs human sign-off. NSAP portal FAQ Q17 (IGNWPS-IN-ELIGIBILITY-01, official source per POLICY.md §3) states '40-59 years'. UMANG/MRD benefit page (IGNWPS-IN-BENEFIT-01, discovery-only per POLICY.md §3) states 'between 40 years and 79 years'. The Maharashtra department page and current practice also cite 79. The FAQ likely predates a revised NSAP guideline raising the ceiling; IGNWPS-MH already encodes 79. Rule value set to 79 pending official NSAP guidelines PDF confirmation. See POLICY.md §2.

rules.source_quote: The applicant must be a widow in the age group of 40-79 years.
The applicant should belong to a household living below the poverty line according to the criteria prescribed by the Govt. of India
In case of remarriage of widow
rules.note: Pension is discontinued on remarriage. The source passage (IGNWPS-IN-EXCLUSION-01) is flagged needs_recollection — discontinuation conditions are not explicitly listed in the NSAP FAQ (Q17-Q19). This rule should be verified against an official NSAP source.
